The following JSON schemas describe ScienceVerse objects.

## bibr paper exports

[`paper.json`](paper.json) is the strict schema for the current **bibr 12.2**
export. It requires `schema_version: "12.2"`, every root table, and every
column the exporter always emits; unknown keys are rejected.

Use [`bibr-export-v12-reader.schema.json`](bibr-export-v12-reader.schema.json)
to consume exports across **12.x** minor versions. It accepts unknown keys
and new vocabulary values while checking known field types and rejecting
other major versions.

This replaces the previous 10.5 paper contract: `info` is now `metadata`,
`info_match` is `metadata_match`, and `affiliations` is `affiliation`.
The export also includes `source`, `extraction`, footnotes, and affiliation
and funding match tables. The old ScienceVerse contract remains available as
[`paper-v10.5.json`](paper-v10.5.json); the upstream v10 and v11 schemas are
also preserved below.

The versioned bibr schemas are unmodified generated artifacts from
[bibr commit 2da14cc](https://github.com/scienceverse/bibr/commit/2da14cce8d34c00e701f706e3cf415943a1f46f3)
and retain their canonical identifiers under `https://bibr.org/schema/`.
`paper.json` contains the same strict contract with its ScienceVerse identifier.
